what: The Apple timing rows, first cut on applegpu_g13s and portable to any certified Apple GPU family (cert8.py --architecture <the family>): the identical-case ladder of pml_3d and the three cases the extended ladder adds (pml_3d_lorentz, dispersive; pml_3d_monitors, monitor-heavy; pml_3d_hz, a source on a fused seam) at the three sizes of record and the two smaller ones, the Metal route, three passes, with the labelled context legs the site names; and the fused-product rows the Metal dispatch-preference record is cut from (every DRIVE case the release dispatches on the Metal table, and the size sweep), named for the architecture they are timed on (metal_kernels/timing_applegpu_g13s.json on the M1 Max), each fused unit run with MEEP_GPU_HARDWARE=certified.

ladder.context: the context legs (--controls context) are named by the SITE, never here: --context-meep ctx-native=<python>,<mpirun>,<build record> and --context-meep ctx-cfdouble=<python>,<mpiexec>,<build record> in the --ladder-params file; without them the control is omitted by name. No hybrid row: the macOS MEEP builds link no OpenMP of their own
